items.name: theme
items.title: Neutral theme
items.description: The neutral theme as plain custom properties, derived from React Aria's starter (Apache-2.0)

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface and a frame with parts: `Card.Header`, `Card.Body`, `Card.Footer`

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, a hint and an error: the ids and the ARIA are `createField`'s

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: APG modal dialog: a scrim, a panel on the surface, focus in and back, and Escape or the backdrop to close

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: An edge-anchored panel on Dialog (Modal): a side rail or a bottom sheet, with the focus trap, Escape, the backdrop, the scroll lock and the focus return

items.name: panzoom
items.title: Pan and zoom
items.description: One image in a frame: drag to pan, pinch or Ctrl/⌘ + wheel to zoom, a double click or Reset to go back, and the keys and the live value that stand in for every gesture

items.name: scrollspy
items.title: Scrollspy
items.description: A table of contents whose current entry is the last heading to pass the top of its scroll container, indented by level and marked `aria-current=location`

items.name: diagram
items.title: Diagram
items.description: A graph of nodes and edges drawn in SVG: one roving tab stop over the nodes, arrows that follow the layout, Enter for the outgoing edges of a node, and a live region that says where the user is

items.name: shortcuts
items.title: Shortcuts
items.description: A keyboard-shortcuts sheet opened by `?`: the kit's dialog with a group per area and a key cap per chord, and the registry the page binds its own chords to

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field on the neutral theme, and the control `Field` puts in by default

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A toolbar: `role=toolbar`, a name, and a size the controls inside read as their context

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: Buttons in one line: the corners two neighbours share and the border between them are the group's, not a prop's

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: APG switch on @cssints/headless, on the neutral theme, with its scenario test

items.name: disclosure
items.title: Disclosure
items.description: APG disclosure on @cssints/headless, on the neutral theme, with its scenario test

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: APG button and toggle button: `tone` and `size` variants, and `render` for a link

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: APG checkbox, including the mixed tri-state, on @cssints/headless

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio group
items.description: APG radio group with roving tabindex or aria-activedescendant focus

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: APG tabs: roving tabindex, automatic or manual activation, wrapped arrows

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: APG accordion: multiple or single expansion, headed triggers, collapsible

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A rule between two groups: `role=separator` with its orientation, or a decorative `role=none`

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label in three tones, a pill at 999px because the theme's steps stop at 16px

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder box that pulses only when the reader has not asked for less motion

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: APG alert: a title and a body in a live region, with an `invalid` tone

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Drop zone
items.description: A file drop target: a dashed zone, a browse button over the primitive's hidden input, and a live region for the last batch

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: APG meter: a track and the fill of the value, on `createMeter`

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: APG breadcrumb: a trail whose current page is marked `aria-current=page` and painted from it

items.name: treeview
items.title: Tree view
items.description: APG tree view: roving focus, expanded rows and levels on `createTreeview`

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: APG menu button: one trigger, a list with a roving tab stop, arrows, Home and End, Escape and a click outside to close; a variant gives the rows checkbox and radio items

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: APG menu and menubar: a roving bar whose menus float under their items, rows with one tab stop, and nested submenus that open beside the parent row

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: APG tooltip: a text bubble on hover and on focus, wired to its trigger by `aria-describedby`

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal panel anchored to a trigger: a dialog surface that flips at the viewport edge, closes on an outside press or Escape, and returns the focus

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A calendar in a popover: a 6x7 month grid with arrows, Home and End, PageUp and PageDown, min and max, and the chosen day on the trigger

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: APG select-only combobox: the button that shows the chosen label is the combobox, a floating listbox follows it with `aria-activedescendant`, and Enter, Tab or a click commits

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: A modal dialog with a search field: the primitive filters the commands, `aria-activedescendant` marks the active row, and arrows, Enter, Escape and a hotkey are its keys

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field styled like `Input`, and the control `Field` puts in with `render`

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: APG slider: the rail, the fill and the thumb, with the fill's share of the rail from `aria-valuenow`

items.name: slider-multithumb
items.title: Range slider
items.description: APG multi-thumb slider: two thumbs whose bounds follow each other, and the interval between them as the fill

items.name: spinbutton
items.title: Spinbutton
items.description: APG spinbutton: a number field with steppers it disables at the bounds, and the id a `Field` names it by

items.name: checkbox-group
items.title: Checkbox group
items.description: APG tri-state checkbox group: three of the kit's `Checkbox`, and the all/none/mixed parent derived from them

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A queue of toasts in a portalled fixed stack: info, success and error tones, a close button, and a countdown that pauses while the pointer or the focus is on the toast

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: A data table on a native `<table>`: sortable headers whose arrow is `aria-sort`, row selection with a select-all that covers the rendered rows, a numeric column right-aligned from the column's hint, and an optional window over 10 000 rows that keeps `aria-rowcount` and every `aria-rowindex`

items.name: virtual-list
items.title: Virtual list
items.description: A scrolling list on `createVirtualizer`: only the declared rows are built (10 000 rows cost a screenful), two spacers stand in for the rest, and every row announces its place in the whole set

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: A page list in a nav: the current page is `aria-current=page` and painted from it, the elided runs are text, the ends stay in place, and one live status announces the count
